operations.title: The physical conductor boundary has zero elliptic infinity-Gysin image on the nonsoft open
operations.statement: The conductor roots are finite, with R1(infinity)=-x, R2(infinity)=y, and R3(infinity)=z. On the nonsoft open the conductor support is disjoint from the elliptic infinity divisor, so support base change forces the elliptic infinity-Gysin image to vanish; any conditional supported pushforward lies in the rank-seven T7 sector.
